title: LPC Monsters
_comment: A monster set for battle scenes. Each entry is a standalone LPC enemy sheet of 64px cells laid out as rows of facings (up, left, down, right) x columns of animation frames. Unlike a character 'cast', a monster is not a stack of layers — it is one finished sheet the scene compositor slices a single facing/frame from. Geometry (cols x rows) is derived from the PNG; only non-default facing rows or frame sizes need to be named here. Art: the CC0/OGA lpc-monsters set (see CREDITS.csv).
